content: The Yazd enemies succeeded in stirring up the opinion of the Herat scholars, so that Shāhrukh summoned Ibn Turka to the capital to be tried again. On this second trip he wrote the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I and the creedal tract R. Iʿtiqādāt, both dated 829/1426 and addressed to Shāhrukh, and 'again earned Shāhrukh's favor' and returned to Fars.
